caption:
Last sheet? Change the roll

One sheet left on the roll. Cella takes it, changes the roll, and leaves it ready.

For whoever leaves it ready for the next one.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with a voice on a flat color background in a bedroom. At the top, the words: 1 sheet left. For whoever changes the roll. A small doorway-shaped figure with white eyes stands to the left, looking at a paper roll on a small wall bracket on the right with one sheet hanging from it. The words appear one line at a time: one sheet left. I take it (the sheet floats over to the figure and vanishes). I change the roll (the empty tube drops to the floor, and a fresh roll arcs in from the right onto the bracket). Now it is ready (the new roll shows a neat folded tip and a star appears). The closing line: for whoever leaves it ready for the next one. Then: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: Cella changed the roll today. Somebody left it ready for her.
evolucion: Dos apuestas (junta-ene-s1, seccion 3). (a) El cierre con persona, sin pedido: ninguna pieza pide guardar, comentar, compartir, enviar ni seguir (regla 8); el fijado es una frase de Cella que nombra al destinatario. Base de lectura: N2 16 % (14 de 88 Reels), 1,5 envios por 1.000 de alcance, mediana de alcance 117; con el mismo corte de la hora 168. (b) El destinatario como gancho: brazo A (abre con "For whoever ..." en el cuadro 0 y vuelve a cerrar) contra brazo B (solo cierra). Se mide a 48 h con medir.py (envios por 1.000 de alcance, vistas comprometidas) y a 7 dias con objetivos.py (N2, N4). Con 17 seguidores no separa causa de ruido: lectura de orden de magnitud. Semana sin largos ni medios (prueba 3a del acta).
